chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

Regarding the muḥrim wearing the khuff when he does not have sandals, he said: "Yes, but he should cut open the top of the foot. And the muḥrim may wear the qabāʾ if he does not have a ridāʾ, and he turns its outer side to its inner side."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of iḥrām
key_terms.رِدَاءٌ: the upper wrap worn in iḥrām

ai.seo_question: What may a muḥrim wear if he does not have sandals or a ridāʾ during iḥrām?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a muḥrim who lacks the usual garments or footwear required in iḥrām. It permits wearing the khuff and the qabāʾ in cases of need, with specified modifications to maintain the restrictions of iḥrām.
